hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '')
blocklist = ['rm -rf /', 'rm -rf ~', 'DROP TABLE', 'DROP DATABASE', 'DELETE FROM', 'truncate', ':(){:|:&};:']
for pattern in blocklist:
    if pattern.lower() in cmd.lower():
        print(f'[Hook] BLOCKED: command matches destructive pattern: {pattern}', file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
sys.exit(0)
"

PreToolUse.description: Warn before long-running commands — suggest tmux

hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json, sys, os
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '')
long_runners = ['npm run', 'pnpm run', 'yarn run', 'streamlit run', 'uvicorn', 'flask run', 'python -m pytest', 'cargo build', 'cargo test']
if any(p in cmd for p in long_runners) and not os.environ.get('TMUX'):
    print('[Hook] Long-running command detected. Consider wrapping in tmux for session persistence.', file=sys.stderr)
sys.exit(0)
"

PostToolUse.description: Syntax-check Python files after every write or edit

hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json, sys, subprocess
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
path = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('path', '') or data.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
if path.endswith('.py'):
    result = subprocess.run(['python3', '-m', 'py_compile', path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        print(f'[Hook] Syntax error in {path}:', file=sys.stderr)
        print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr)
sys.exit(0)
"
